phase: Accounting Spine / F4 ECB RAS reserve-template non-reopen diagnostic
purpose: Determine whether the ECB International Reserves (RAS) loan series for Romania's central bank supplies a definitionally comparable counterpart constraint capable of reopening the frozen F4 stock boundary.

current_F4_boundary.unresolved_stock_boundary: BNR-holder F4 asset stock is 6.1 million RON at 2025-Q4 but lacks exact allocation across H/C/F/G/X.

observed_dimensions.interpretation: Other foreign currency assets (not included in official reserve assets), loans, counterpart aggregate 'other sectors than MFIs'.
Quarterly sector accounts / ESA financial accounts, all currencies, standard valuation.

boundary_comparison.frequency_difference: RAS monthly versus QSA quarterly; frequency alone does not create the required counterpart split.
boundary_comparison.statistical_domain_difference: RAS is an international-reserves reserve-template series, not the QSA/ESA financial-accounts matrix governing canonical F4.
boundary_comparison.currency_scope_difference: RAS X1 covers currencies other than national domestic currency; canonical QSA F4 uses all currencies (_T).
boundary_comparison.valuation_difference: RAS uses nominal value (N); QSA uses standard SNA/ESA valuation (S).
boundary_comparison.counterpart_scope_difference: RAS provides S1Q 'other sectors than MFIs', not exact H/C/F/G/X counterpart sectors.
boundary_comparison.transaction_history_difference: The reviewed RAS candidate is a stock series and does not supply the missing bilateral 2025 QSA F4 transaction constraints.

adjudication.reason: The RAS series is a narrower foreign-currency reserve-template stock with different valuation and only an S1Q aggregate counterpart. It is not definitionally identical to the QSA/ESA all-currency F4 stock and cannot resolve the four remaining BNR-holder allocation degrees of freedom.
